commits.a1b2c3d4e: Restrict exports to the caller's own account
commits.4f2c9a1b7: Override the account filter after decoding

issues.title: Filter quoting lets a caller export another account's data
issues.note: fixed by overriding the account after decoding

locations.what: restrictFilter: the account number is now set in the decoded map

detail: The string guard dropped only a filter piece equal to the key name, and an unclosed quote then swallowed the appended account, so the caller's own value won.
issues.verified: Reproduced at a1b2c3d4e by a controller-level test; the service layer was stubbed. The fix was confirmed by reading the code at 4f2c9a1b7.

fix.what: The controller decodes the filter first, then overwrites the account number in the decoded map.
fix.behavior: Quote tricks in the filter can no longer change the scope of the export.

issues.title: Expired keys keep working offline

locations.what: findExportKeys: no check of the expiration time

detail: The export query ignores the expiration time.
issues.verified: From reading the code: keys of this type are created without an expiration, and no update path exists.

dismissal.by: Claude, while verifying the findings at the reviewer's request; no human sign-off recorded
dismissal.reason: Not reachable: keys of this type cannot expire today.

log.text: First round at a1b2c3d4e: 1 open, 1 dismissed.
